items.summary: Kalpataru Projects International Ltd (KPIL) announced securing domestic work orders worth ₹2,349 crore in EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) orders in transmission and distribution (T&D) and buildings and factories (B&F) segments. The company said it enjoys strong momentum, with inflows crossing ₹2000 crore. The company offers EPC solutions in various sectors and aims for sustainable growth in the future.
